glosses: short person, especially one who suffers from dwarfism
dwarf (member of a short, underground humanoid race)
anything that is small in stature or importance

examples.text: Por incrível que pareça, as estrelas anãs podem ser 20 vezes maior que o nosso Sol.
examples.en: As crazy as it seems, dwarf stars can be 20 times bigger than our sun.
